name: network_discovery
description: Network Discovery — SABLE auto-discovers a live /24 (real nmap/SNMP scan, sanitized), builds the topology itself, then infers the HIDDEN blast radius: with only the gateway monitored, it calls three unseen hosts unreachable the instant the uplink drops. Topology is real; the incident is a labelled simulation.

recommendations.summary: 5/5 nodes affected: 2 failed, 3 unreachable. Root cause likely Internet Gateway (observed).

actions.reason: 6 discovered nodes depend on it; downstream symptoms point here.
actions.recommendation: Check the uplink/gateway path, DNS reachability, and recent changes.
